The task failed due to #NAME? errors in the Excel workbook's statistics section, indicating invalid formula syntax or undefined function names.
The test_derived_values_and_stats failed with an AssertionError in test_outputs.py. Specifically, cells H46 through L47 in the 'Task' worksheet returned #NAME? instead of the expected float values (e.g., H46 expected -1.7216, got #NAME?). This error typically occurs when openpyxl writes a formula containing a typo or a function that the evaluator does not recognize.
